sentences.text:
Addl. Chief Secy. Home Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Kumar Singh,Ram Prakash Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ram Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Rajiv Kumar
Verma, learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the
records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing
Case Crime No.380 of 2022, under Sections 406/420/467/468/471/34 I.P.C., registered at Police
Station Imaliya Sultanpur, District Sitapur.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 30.09.2022 against one S.K. Chauhan, stating that three persons came to the applicant about five months ago and under allurement of getting him a dealership of Shaktiman Urea they took a bank draft of Rs.80,000/- in the name of Shaktiman Agriteck but later on they became untraceable.
Vinod Kumar Alias Vinod Kumar Awasthi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182179915/
1 4.

entities.text: Vinod Kumar Alias Vinod Kumar Awasthi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application it has been contended that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant disclosing the applicant's involvement in three other cases.

5. The learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and on the basis of instructions he has submitted that in the additional statement of the informant he stated that three persons who had come to dupe the informant, included the applicant.
He has further stated that several other persons have been duped in a similar manner.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts do not warrant exercise of discretion of this court by granting pre-arrest bail to the applicant.
7. The anticipatory bail application of the applicant is rejected.

However, in case the applicant files an application for grant of bail, the same shall be considered and decided on its merits, without being influenced by any observations made by this court in this order.
.

(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Ram.
